name: peek
description: See the pictures Claude looks at: under each Read or screenshot in the conversation, a thumbnail (large under ctrl+o). Real pictures where the terminal draws them, coloured blocks elsewhere

size.title: Picture size in the conversation
size.description: small: a thumbnail about 8 rows tall. large: up to 16 rows and the full width. ctrl+o always draws them large

picture.title: How pictures are drawn
picture.description: auto: the terminal's own pictures where it draws them (kitty, Ghostty, iTerm2 in fullscreen), coloured blocks elsewhere. image or blocks: always that
